blocks.code: Large language models are, at their core, stateless function approximators: given a prompt x, they produce a distribution over continuations pθ (y | x). Every inference call begins from scratch. The context window—the finite sequence of tokens the model can attend to—is the only information available at generation time. For short, self-contained tasks this is sufficient. For long-horizon agentic tasks it is a fundamental bottleneck. The Context-Window Bottleneck Let L denote the maximum context length (e.g. L = 128,000 tokens for GPT-4o). A single token encodes roughly 4 characters; a typical book contains ∼ 500,000 words ≈ 670,000 tokens. Even ignoring cost, a multi-day autonomous agent accumulates observations, tool outputs, and reasoning traces that cannot fit in any fixed window. Memory systems are the engineering response to this physical constraint. Three distinct failure modes arise when agents lack persistent memory:

blocks.code: Memory as Cognitive Architecture Cognitive science distinguishes several memory systems in biological agents [337, 356]: working memory (active manipulation of information), episodic memory (autobiographical events), semantic memory (world knowledge), and procedural memory (skills and habits). Effective agentic AI systems benefit from analogous distinctions—not because we are simulating neuroscience, but because these categories reflect genuinely different access patterns, update frequencies, and retrieval mechanisms. blocks.originalExcerpt: The blackboard pattern [135] is a classic multi-agent coordination mechanism: Each agent reads from and writes to the blackboard. blocks.text: 阅读 §17.9「Evaluating Memory Systems」 时，先按“输入—状态—控制流—输出”还原原书描述，再追踪每个组件由谁执行、数据写到哪里、失败会怎样向下游传播。这样可以避免只记住组件名称，却无法解释完整运行路径。
评估Agent记忆具有挑战性，因为记忆操作的质量只是通过远期下游任务性能间接揭示出来的。如果一个记忆系统能够完全回想起存储的事实，如果它能检索不相关的上下文或覆盖LLM的context window，那么它仍然会失败。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Evaluating agentic memory is challenging because the quality of memory operations is only revealed indirectly—through downstream task performance over long horizons. A memory system that achieves perfect recall of stored facts can still fail if it retrieves irrelevant context or overwhelms the LLM’s context window.

blocks.text: 读取-参考-写入循环 内存-增强的Agent循环执行一个四阶段认知循环:
blocks.originalExcerpt: The Read-Act-Reflect-Write Cycle The memory-augmented agent loop implements a four-phase cognitive cycle:

blocks.text: 1. 读作:在行动前，检索相关记忆，以告知答复。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Read: Before acting, retrieve relevant memories to inform the response.

blocks.text: 2. 行为:生成以检索上下文为条件的反应。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Act: Generate a response conditioned on retrieved context.

blocks.text: 3. 反思:定期综合从累积记忆中得出的更高层次的见解。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Reflect: Periodically synthesize higher-level insights from accumulated memories.

blocks.text: 4. 写作:有选择地将重要的新信息输入持续储存。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 4. Write: Selectively commit important new information to persistent storage.

blocks.text: 这个循环反映了军事战略中的观察-定向-决定行为(OODA)循环和认知心理学中的编码-存储-检索模型。 关键洞察力在于记忆不是被动存储而是认知的积极参与者。
blocks.originalExcerpt: This cycle mirrors the observe-orient-decide-act (OODA) loop from military strategy and the encode-store-retrieve model from cognitive psychology. The key insight is that memory is not a passive store but an active participant in cognition.
